title: Trade-In Agreements Policy Clause on Distributing Positive Equity
content:
**Clause.** Positive equity on a **Trade-In Agreements** agreement is distributed only once its amount is final: after the lien payoff has been sent, or after pickup when there is no lien. Equity is distributed only on an agreement whose status is picked up. For a trade linked to a purchase order that is still contracted, the whole positive equity balance is applied to that order as a trade equity payment within the equity apply business days. For an outright sale, or when the linked purchase order is no longer contracted (cancelled before the equity was applied), the equity is paid to the customer by ACH or check within the payout business days, and only after a transferable title or lien release is in hand when the payout hold switch is true. Equity is never split between the purchase and a payout. When the linked purchase is later returned under the 7-day return, Kestrel keeps the traded vehicle and the purchase refunds the applied equity to the customer as cash; the trade agreement itself is not reopened.

**Amount distributed.** The equity to distribute is the higher of zero and the agreement's undistributed trade equity; a balance at or below zero distributes nothing.

## Where the equity goes

| Situation of the picked-up agreement | Destination | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| Linked purchase order still contracted | Applied to that order, whole balance, as a trade equity payment | Within the equity apply business days |
| Outright sale | Paid to the customer by ACH or check | Within the payout business days; after a transferable title or lien release is in hand when the payout hold switch is true |
| Linked purchase order no longer contracted (cancelled before the equity was applied) | Paid to the customer by ACH or check | As for an outright sale |

## When the amount is final

| Lien on the vehicle | Equity is final |
|---|---|
| Yes | After the lien payoff has been sent |
| No | After pickup |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

An agreement shows undistributed trade equity of $2350.00 after its payoff was sent, and its purchase order is still contracted: the full $2350.00 is applied to that order. Had the balance been less than zero, the amount to distribute would be zero.

## Points of judgement

- **Part to the purchase, part to the customer?** Never; the equity is not split.
- **Purchase returned after equity was applied?** Kestrel keeps the vehicle; the purchase refunds the applied equity to the customer as cash, and the trade agreement stays closed.
